title: Exam definition body
description: An exam the Registrar runs (academy.md 3, AC-7, register row DK25). Signed by the Registrar. The pass mark is part of the definition and is set BEFORE any sitting is scored: the log refuses an exam result whose pass mark differs, and refuses a second definition with the same exam id (a changed pass mark is a new exam id). The pool is the number of task variants (at least 40); suite_hash commits to the pool, which is published after a season, not before. Chain: none (prev is null). Credits are accounting entries, not money.

exam.description: The exam's id, for example foundations-v1.

pass_mark_permille.description: The score (0 to 1000) a sitting needs to pass, fixed here before scoring.

pool_size.description: How many task variants the pool holds.

categories.description: The task categories; a failed sitting names the ones missed, never the answers.

sitting_service.description: The price-list service the sitting fee is bought with (from the Academy).
